slides.texte_overlay:
How to get noticed by women
without trying too hard
Be good company to everyone. The guy who makes his friends laugh and includes the quiet one is the one people notice.
Take care of your skin, hair and smell. Simple daily grooming shows you respect yourself without trying to impress.
Do things you love in public places. Play pick-up football, join a dance class, go to an art opening. Passion shows naturally.
Be calm and relaxed. No showing off, no forced jokes. A man at ease with himself is rare and easy to notice. Relax and enjoy the moment.
Before: I had little to talk about. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and conversations now flow easily.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had little to talk about. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Conversations now flow easily.

slides.texte_overlay: Be polite and warm with staff. Waiters, cashiers, bartenders. Kindness to strangers says more about you than anything else.
Respect every answer. Friendly, never pushy, and happy to move on. Respect is what leaves a lasting good impression.
